mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_request SET requested_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_ip=#{ip} WHERE username=#{username} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, status, attempts, request_ip AS "requestIp", requested_at AS "requestedAt", approved_by AS "approvedBy", approved_at AS "approvedAt", expires_at AS "expiresAt", used_at AS "usedAt" FROM password_reset_request WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','USED') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, requested_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_request SET status='REJECTED', approved_by=#{admin}, approved_at=LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, code_hash AS "codeHash", attempts FROM password_reset_request WHERE username=#{username} AND status='APPROVED' AND expires_at > LOCALTIMESTAMP ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_request SET status='USED', used_at=LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM password_reset_request WHERE id=#{id}
